login.signIn: Sign in to Traycer once in the ademark account: click Sign in on the Welcome screen and approve it in the browser. Stay signed in; reset() keeps ~/.traycer/cli/credentials and the Host's enrollment in ~/.traycer/host/identity.

orchestrationTrigger.notCalibrated: ADES.md 3.5: child agents with agent-to-agent messages; artifact skills start one child agent per ticket. No trigger line is proven.

notes: PLACEHOLDER: orchestrationTrigger null means UNKNOWN here, not 'no orchestration'. ADES 3.5 says child agents exist, and C1 reports null as 'not supported'. Do not run C1 until the trigger line is decided.

Sign-in: the owner signs in to Traycer (login.kind app; the sign-in file is ~/.traycer/cli/credentials). Claude Code and Codex are set up in Traycer Settings > Providers (control names unverified). Installed here: claude 2.1.310 at ~/.local/bin/claude and codex 0.163.0 at ~/.local/bin/codex; the bench expects claude 2.1.303, which is not installed. If managed agent credentials live under ~/.traycer (location unverified), reset wipes them unless they are listed in login.files.

Telemetry: no in-app switch found in the bundle. PostHog key is hard-coded in the renderer (analytics chunk) and Sentry DSN in the main process; the Electron crash reporter has uploadToServer false once in the main bundle, not tied to Traycer's own init. Confirm in Settings in the GUI session; if no switch exists, ADES rule 1 telemetry-off is not achievable from config.
Auto-update: the app checks in the background and does not download on its own (autoUpdater.autoDownload is false in the main process). No settings key was found.

The Traycer host (ai.traycer.host.agent, KeepAlive) is a LaunchAgent inside the app bundle. It is attributed by bundle path, so waitForPid by bundle path can attach to the host instead of the app when a host is already running. Reset kills and boots it out first.

New-thread shortcut is cmd+n (epic.new, 'New task'), which opens the start page for a Task, not a chat thread. Its composer focus after the shortcut is unverified; focusClick is null until a GUI check.

Versions: Desktop 1.5.1, Electron 42.11.12, bundle SHA-256 computed with shasum on the main executable (matches pins/versions.json binary_sha256 and team_id). The bundle holds two CLI builds, Resources/cli/darwin-arm64/traycer and the host copy in Library/LaunchAgents/Traycer Host.app; their SHA-256 differ. The host version is set up at first launch (docs first-run) and is not pinned by this profile.

2026-11-11: calibration.probe xkvw. The composer's placeholder ('Ask anything, @tag files/folder, or use / to show available commands') holds pairs of the default probe ademarkqz ('de' in folder, and for Traycer 'ma' in commands), and the native rule takes any new probe pair in the region as Ready. On 10 and 11 Nov every A1 and A2 repetition reached Ready on the placeholder (frames.json: the Ready frame reads the placeholder, the caret blinks over its first letter, and no typed letter ever shows, because the typing stops at Ready). No ordinary word has xk, kv, vw or wx, so Ready can only be typed text. The rows of those nights were invalid ('Ready came from text that is not the probe'), never a false time.
